title: Silk-based microparticles for the adsorption of methylene blue: formulations, characterization, adsorption study, in silico molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,14042-14057
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02266E, Paper
Open Access

Duy Toan Pham, Phuong T. M. Ha, Ngoc Bich Pham, Ngoc Yen Nguyen, Ngoc Thanh Vo, Dang Khoa Dang, Danh Si Ra, Anh Minh Pham-Phan, Manh Quan Nguyen, Bui Thi Phuong Thuy
Silk fibroin microparticles (FNP) showed superior methylene blue adsorption vs. raw silk. FNP's structure, surface charge, and molecular interactions (Lys62, Glu94) proved key, supported by docking and dynamics simulations.
